Status.description_en:
The status of the modification record. Valid values:

PENDING: Pending execution

MODIFYING: Modifying (updating the parent task ticket for table removal or creating a subtask for table addition)

RUNNING: Running (subtask is running)

MERGING: Merging (parent and child tasks meet merge conditions)

TERMINATED: Terminated

SUCCESS: Successful

FAILED: Failed

CANCEL: Canceled
Status.description_zh:
修改记录的状态，包括：
PENDING：待执行
MODIFYING：修改中（减表修改父任务工单的执行，加表创建子任务）
RUNNING：运行中（子任务运行中）
MERGING：合并中（父子任务符合合并条件）
TERMINATED：已终止
SUCCESS：成功
FAILED：失败
CANCEL：已取消
Status.title_zh: 修改记录状态 (PENDING: 待执行, MODIFYING: 修改中（减表修改父项目工单的执行，加表创建子项目）, RUNNING: 运行中（子项目运行中）, MERGING: 合并中（父子项目符合合并条件）, TERMINATED: 已终止, SUCCESS: 成功, FAILED: 失败, CANCEL: 已取消)
